_about: Collision footprints measured by hand on a metre grid (scripts/town-builder/measure-footprint.mjs) where the automatic base is wrong. Metres from the sprite anchor at scale 1, unflipped: u along +X, v along +Y. Each box: half sizes hx, hy and centre dx, dy. 'door' (optional) = where a visitor stands. Read by export-game.mjs and collision-audit.mjs.
